description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and an outbuilding in rear garden following demolition of existing storeroom.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( ART/2021/RE93HR/SPLP; ART/2021/RE93HR/ELPL; ART/2021/RE93HR/PE; ART/2021/RE93HR/EE. Received: 10 June 2021. ART/2021/RE93HR/ELPL Rev B. Received: 30/06/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension and outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extension and outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The hereby approved detached single storey outbuilding shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house known as 93 Hall Road, Isleworth, TW7 7PB and for no other purpose.  A purpose incidental to a dwelling house would not cover normal residential uses, such as separate self-contained accommodation nor the use of an outbuilding for primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, or kitchen.
